name: Hsü Chih-mo
bio: Hsü Chih-mo (徐志摩, Xu Zhimo; 1897–1931) was a leading poet of the Crescent Moon (Xinyue) circle, which sought to give modern Chinese verse regular form and musical measure. He studied in the United States and then in England, where he spent 1921–22 at King’s College, Cambridge, an experience that shaped much of his later poetry.

He edited and wrote for the Xinyue journal and published several collections, among them 猛虎集 (The Fierce Tiger, 1931). He was killed in an air crash in Shandong in November 1931, aged thirty-four. “再別康橋” (Second Farewell to Cambridge), written in 1928, first appeared in Xinyue on 10 December 1928.

poems.title: 再別康橋 (Zai bie kang qiao)
poems.author: Hsü Chih-mo
poems.text:
輕輕的我走了，
正如我輕輕的來；
我輕輕的招手，
作別西天的雲彩。

那河畔的金柳，
是夕陽中的新娘；
波光裏的豔影，
在我的心頭蕩漾。

輭泥上的靑荇，
油油的在水底招搖：
在康河的柔波裏，
我甘心做一條水草！

那楡蔭下的一潭，
不是淸泉，是天上虹
揉碎在浮藻間，
沈澱着彩虹似的夢。

尋夢？撑一支長篙，
向靑草更靑處漫溯，
滿載一船星輝，
在星輝斑斕裏放歌。

但我不能放歌，
悄悄是別離的笙簫；
夏蟲也爲我沈默，
沈默是今晚的康橋！

悄悄的我走了，
正如我悄悄的來；
我揮一揮衣袖，
不帶走一片雲彩。
